name: jurnie
description: Connect your Jurnie account to review goals and manage tasks, habits, and daily follow-through.

interface.longDescription: Connect your Jurnie account to review personal and shared Journeys, plan the day, manage and assign tasks, track habits, set intentions, work with calendar events, and schedule follow-through. Access follows the permissions you choose during Jurnie sign-in.
defaultPrompt: Review my Jurnie priorities and plan today.
Show my overdue tasks and suggest the next three actions.
Assign a Journey task to the right team member.
